subject: integration conflict: apps/api/naadi_api/config_api/schemas.py, apps/web/src/router.tsx, config/app_co
body:
Rebase onto claude/naadi-shared conflicted in:
- apps/api/naadi_api/config_api/schemas.py
- apps/web/src/router.tsx
- config/app_config.yaml

Recent integration commits touching them:
feat(web): flashcard review (/cards) with FSRS-6 previews equal to the server, create/edit/delete dialog, offline ratings outbox
feat(api): flashcards with server-authoritative FSRS-6 (fsrs 6.3.3): due list, create/edit/delete, idempotent reviews, stats
feat(exam): S09 timed and exam modes, server-authoritative timer, navigator and tools, Results analytics
ink: every string is a ui_copy key; scroll pairs alternate order
feat(health): agent_runtime carries structured facts; the diagnostics page words them with ui_copy
feat(web): every S03 route/shell string from ui_copy; no-hardcoded-copy test; Google flow always tested; run-once auth project
fix(learn): error messages from ui_copy by failure kind, never the server's English (request id kept)
fix(courses): mock exams are not listed or readable in /learn (404 for chapter and reading position); contract drops mock_exams
fix(reader): S06 review: ui_copy for all reader text, sandboxed Mermaid, page arrows, scroll padding, phone bar
fix(qbank): review round 1 - graded-attempt card gate, no client delete/correct read (0010), mock questions exam-only, deterministic weak-spot test, builder legends, ui_copy literals, past-block states, single-block reuse, amber-ink token, lab-values provenance
fix(search): S07 review - strip mock answer keys at import, exclude mock content from the index, hydrate re-checks source rule and current text, structured meta + ui_copy wording, reindex hook after seed, phone tab bar, shortcut guards, auto-web rules, smoke script, low-priority index thread
feat(agent): diagnostics media answer block, friendly errors, review UI items; e2e only migrates a loopback or explicit test database
fix(web): empty result always says so; web panel follows automatically when nothing matches locally
feat(web): search wording from required ui_copy keys (search.*), shipped defaults regenerated
feat(web): Search screen (/search, Ctrl/Cmd+K, nav search button), search ui_copy, relevance floor, CI + image model cache, e2e and db tests

My branch is unchanged (rebase aborted).
